rationale: Georgi is building AI-agent automation for GTM workflows at early-stage startups, while Parth brings hands-on hardware testing and mechanical engineering experience from the robotics space at Tesla. This is a complementary pairing where Parth's robotics hardware rigor could inform how Rilo thinks about testing and validation of multi-agent systems in production, and Georgi's expertise in scaling small teams through automation could apply to Parth's hardware engineering workflows.
intro_message: Georgi, meet Parth Behani — a Robotics Hardware Test Engineer at Tesla working on humanoid robotics; his experience validating complex mechanical systems could offer useful perspectives on testing and hardening multi-agent workflows at scale.
